name: FUN_TLM_SENSOR_LOGS
description: This table contains information of sensors. A sensor is an activity that happens in a system where telemetry data needs to be gathered.

columns.name: SENSOR_ID
columns.description: Sensor identifier and primary key.

columns.name: PARENT_SENSOR_ID
columns.description: Sensor identifier of parent sensor record.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the product to which the sensor activity belongs.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the process from where the sensor is gathered.

columns.name: JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Job request identifier obtained from REQUEST_HISTORY.

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: Event name under the sensor activity, also called milestone.

columns.name: DATA_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Name of data item. Possible values include START_TIME, END_TIME, COMPLETED_ACTION, and so on.

columns.name: DATA_ITEM_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to data item.

columns.name: DIMENSION1_CODE
columns.description: Name of first dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION1_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to first dimension.

columns.name: DIMENSION2_CODE
columns.description: Name of second dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION2_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to second dimension.

columns.name: DIMENSION3_CODE
columns.description: Name of third dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION3_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to third dimension.

columns.name: DIMENSION4_CODE
columns.description: Name of fourth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION4_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to fourth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION5_CODE
columns.description: Name of fifth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION5_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to fifth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION6_CODE
columns.description: Name of sixth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION6_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to sixth dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION7_CODE
columns.description: Name of seventh dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: DIMENSION7_VALUE
columns.description: Value corresponding to seventh dimension of instrumentation.

columns.name: COMPLETION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the sensor is complete or in progress.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
